data.gender_notes: Myrtia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Myrtia was a goddess of fertility and growth. Her name comes from the myrtle tree, which symbolizes love, happiness, and good fortune. The name Myrtia carries the meaning “Goddess of fertility” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Myrtia usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of fertility and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Myrtia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of fertility.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Myrtia total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: מירטיה
in_hebrew.meaning: קשורה לעץ המורטה, סמל של אהבה ונאמנות
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם מירטיה קשור לעץ המורטה, שהוא סמל של אהבה, נאמנות וידידות בכתבי הקודש. המורטה הוא עץ ים תיכוני שפריו משמש להכנת זרי הדפנה וזר פרחים. בעת העתיקה, העץ היה סמל של אהבה ואהבה נצחית. השם מירטיה הוא שילוב של השם היווני μυρτος (מורטוס) עם הסיומת הנשית -יה, ומשמעותו 'אדומת הפנים' או 'בעלת עור המורטה'.

in_greek.name: Μυρτία
in_greek.meaning: Σχετίζεται με το μυρτό δέντρο, σύμβολο αγάπης και πιστότητας
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μυρτία συνδέεται με το μυρτό δέντρο, το οποίο είναι σύμβολο αγάπης, πιστότητας και φιλίας στα Ιερά Κείμενα. Το μυρτό είναι ένα μεσογειακό δέντρο, οι καρποί του οποίου χρησιμοποιούνται για την παρασκευή στεφάνων και ανθέων. Στην αρχαιότητα, το δέντρο ήταν σύμβολο αιώνιας αγάπης και πιστότητας. Το όνομα Μυρτία είναι ένας συνδυασμός του ελληνικού ονόματος μυρτος (myrtos) με την θηλυκή κατάληξη -ία, και σημαίνει 'κόρη με το πρόσωπο σαν το μυρτό' ή 'εκείνη που έχει το δέρμα σαν το μυρτό'.

in_latin.name: Myrtia
in_latin.meaning: Related to the myrtle tree, symbol of love and fidelity
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Myrtia is connected to the myrtle tree, which is a symbol of love, fidelity, and friendship in Sacred Scriptures. The myrtle is a Mediterranean tree, its fruits used to make wreaths and garlands. In ancient times, the tree was a symbol of eternal love and loyalty. The name Myrtia is derived from the Greek name μυρτος (myrtos) and the Latin suffix -ia, meaning 'she who has the face of myrtle' or 'the one with skin like myrtle'.

in_english.name: Myrtia
in_english.meaning: Derived from myrtle tree, symbolizing love, loyalty, and friendship
in_english.long_meaning: The name Myrtia originates from the myrtle tree, a symbol of love, loyalty, and friendship in Christian tradition. The myrtle tree, native to the Mediterranean region, has been used for centuries to create wreaths and garlands. In biblical times, the myrtle represented eternal love and fidelity. The name Myrtia, derived from the Greek μυρτος (myrtos), signifies a person characterized by love, loyalty, and devotion. It is often associated with the virtues of friendship, commitment, and spiritual growth.
